Hypothesis B relies on evidence from a different alloy system (AlCoCrFeNiWx coatings) and a mechanism (lattice distortion and W-rich intermetallics) that is less clearly linked to maintaining low friction and wear across the entire 25–800 °C range in a CoCrFeNi matrix.
